summary: A buyer-guide shaped "how to choose" page of 9 blocks: a photo head, a lead, six criteria cards, two accordions with a photo, a quote, five lime-star columns and a closing card. Needs six selection criteria and a few partner badges.

sections.note: wide team photo with the title in a translucent lime label centered over it
centered lead paragraph and one line
six tall white rounded cards in two rows of three, each with a lime line icon, a title, a paragraph and a badge or logo row at the bottom (certification, accreditations, software partners)
text left; right three mauve accordion pills with icon and chevron (outsourcing, offshoring, podsourcing)
one wide pale-lime card with a quote mark and a long quote
centered heading and lead; rounded photo left and three slate accordion rows right (step one to three) with icons
mauve-grey band, heading and five columns each with a lime star, a short title and a paragraph
rounded lime card with heading and a black button over a line-art logo mark
